basis: No incremental strict detection or per-track longest-miss effect of GAP beyond continued original C; FRAME adds two adjacent observations in one track, with no longest-miss improvement.
supported_findings: Gradient delivery was verified; FRAME/GAP reduce their training surrogate losses and raise sigmoid evidence relative to CONT. This is not an implementation-disconnected outcome.
GAP exactly matches CONT strict detection vectors in O and S; its U is 29/19 higher, outside foreground 191/194 pixels higher and unmatched area 135/78 pixels higher.

FRAME adds the same two adjacent observations in both arrangements, one low observation, one track, one source; zero added strict losses against CONT. These are not two independent arrangement replications or multi-track recovery.

FRAME has no isolated010 gains against CONT, but neither FRAME nor GAP improves any of the130 full-track longest misses against CONT. Relative to C_init, all branches lengthen three tracks per arrangement and shorten zero.

All branches retain638/646 dual successes vs639 at C_init; two protected frames are now missed in both arrangements vs zero at C_init. These shared continuation losses cannot be specifically attributed to GAP.
All branches lose nonstrict matches against C_init. FRAME partly offsets the continuation loss by10/7 matches vs CONT; GAP offsets7/7.
All branches fit U<=4015, but outside foreground and unmatched component area remain above release in both arrangements. Budget passage alone is not improvement of the full detection tradeoff.
The existing data support a small direct-readout supervision direction; they do not support a new temporal-grouping claim or justify scaling GAP to the next expensive formal comparison.
next_step_interpretation: Retain FRAME as the simpler weak direction if continuing. Prioritize one prespecified retention/stability revision of the existing training objectives, motivated by losses shared with CONT; keep original matching, data, initial C and controls fixed. Choose its scale using training evidence only, not these development recoveries. This is a candidate follow-up, not a demonstrated fix. Do not add another model or claim that the present experiment identifies a unique cause.
limits: One seed and256 extra updates; no convergence or repeatability claim.
FRAME/GAP use one shared lambda but initial gradient ratios differ(.25 vs.1986); absence of improvement does not rule out every optimization setting.
The mean target and background logits both rise; logit margin falls while sigmoid margin rises. These metrics must remain distinct.
Observed paired strict recovery is one track/two frames, not sustained or multi-source recovery.
